profile.name: Afonso Lima
profile.description: Computer Engineering student at FEUP, currently focused on self hosting from my home server. Before that, I built apps and websites that people use every day.

homelab.title: HomeLab
homelab.description: The Linux box under my desk, running 19 self hosted services my family uses every day: passwords, shopping lists, fitness tracking and retro games.
bullets: Docker Compose stacks behind a single Caddy proxy
No port forwarding: local DNS at home, Tailscale outside
Runs my own bots: a GitHub PR reviewer and a League invite responder
Serves this site through a Cloudflare Tunnel
homelab.alt: HomeLab dashboard showing the status of every service

homelab-status.title: Homelab Status
homelab-status.description: Live status of my home server. A collector pushes a heartbeat every 30 seconds to a Cloudflare Worker, which serves JSON to this site and an SVG card to my GitHub profile.
bullets: Push, not pull: nothing in the homelab is exposed
D1 stores snapshots, daily uptime and hourly CPU/RAM, pruned by a daily cron
SVG card, since READMEs can't run JavaScript
Free tier with room to spare: about 2,880 requests a day, rate limited with 429
homelab-status.alt: Architecture of homelab status: the collector on arroz pushes to a Cloudflare Worker with D1, which serves this site and the GitHub README

habitwar.title: HabitWar
habitwar.description: Habit building as a multiplayer competition. Challenge friends, keep your streaks and climb the leaderboard.
bullets: Live on iOS and Android with paying users
Habits proven by photo, timer or location
Auth, subscriptions, push notifications and widgets

portobox.title: Porto Box Cup
portobox.description: The official platform of Porto Box Cup, the largest boxing tournament in the world.
bullets: Event site, team registration dashboard and admin panel

minix.title: Minix Boxing
minix.description: Two player boxing game for MINIX, written in C by a team of four at FEUP, on our own keyboard, mouse, video, timer and RTC drivers.
bullets: Keyboard player hits Q W E R prompts, mouse player pops bubbles
Combos, HP loss on misses, shorter timing windows every round
Character select, pause menu and leaderboard at 1024x768

about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm Afonso Lima, a Computer Engineering student at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Porto. Right now my focus is on self-hosting and open source development, I run my own services on Linux and Docker on a home server, and that's where most of my free time goes. Before that I built HabitWar, a social competition app for iOS and Android that's still live, and I work on web and mobile with React Native, Swift, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. I also write C, C++, Java, and Python. Outside the digital world, I'm a national boxing champion, an important part of my background and identity.
